profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary: Embedded Software Engineer with 13+ years of expertise. Emphasis on the hardware/software interface. I love developing software that touches the real world.

positions.title: Contract Firmware Engineer, Meta Reality Labs
positions.description: Develop firmware for an Augmented Reality system running Zephyr RTOS on custom silicon. Focus on power management, inter-processor communication, and device drivers. Plan, document, and implement features individually and as part of a team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Write software to control small UAV, using ROS and C++, running on Jetson TX2 flight computer
• Integrate TX2 with onboard PX4, Ardupilot and DJI flight controllers, and ground station using MAVLink
• Provide communications between flight computer and custom onboard hardware
• Modify ground station software to include custom controls for drone, using QT

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Write software requirements and documentation
•	Design and develop software to control Xilinx Ultrascale+ SOC and custom avionics hardware
•	Perform software/hardware integration and test
•	Perform validation and verification in accordance with RTCA DO-178C processes

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and develop software to control FPGAs and custom ASICs in an ultrasound imaging system
• Perform software/hardware integration and test
• Write software requirements and documentation
• Perform validation and verification in accordance with FDA 510k processes

positions.title: TCAS Surveillance Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and develop software to control RF hardware in an embedded system
• Perform software/hardware integration and test
• Write software requirements and documentation
• Perform validation and verification in accordance with DO-178B processes

positions.title: Developer Support Technical Router
positions.description:
• Provide first contact for technical support calls, email, and chat
• Provide excellent customer service

positions.title: Software Developer in Test Intern, Tablet PC Group
positions.description:
• Specify, design, and implement Text-to-Ink tool for automation testing
• Integrate tool into team’s automation library

positions.title: Test Lab Intern
positions.description:
• Maintain test lab of computer and telephone equipment
• Maintain Lab website and work order database

positions.title: Quality Assurance Tester
positions.description:
• Playtest children’s software titles
• Write clear and concise bug descriptions
